title: Built-in reference agents (random, greedy, MCTS)
description: Ship a small set of reference agents that demonstrate the agent SDK and serve as baseline opponents. Random: uniform random legal move. Greedy: maximize immediate score delta. MCTS: Monte Carlo tree search with configurable playout budget. Useful for testing, single-player practice, and benchmarking custom agents.
close_reason: RandomAgent (uniform), GreedyAgent (capture-first), MCTSAgent (tree search with UCB1 + random playout). All use AgentSession for local move enumeration. 6 tests.
